bayts.text: You have realised for me the undertaking in the sciences, O Giver of composition and teaching.
Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ) and Answerer (Al-Mujīb),
bless the servant, the Messenger and the Prophet, who preserved me and made clear for me the ropes of my tent,
and grant peace upon him who removes trial toward other than my person, and has accepted my life.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me keenness of intellect in good things, O You Who protected me with family and dwellings.
Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Beautiful (Al-Jamīl) and Generous (Al-Karīm),
bless with a blessing that beautifies my inward and my outward, and completes my intention,
with a peace that makes ease eternal for me, and makes me forget yesterday through my today and tomorrow,
without enemies, or toil, or reckoning, making my whole being the best reckoning (of reward with God),
upon the intercessor possessed of beauty, Aḥmad, him whom my pen with my ink has praised.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And turn the turbidities and fears toward a direction other than mine, and the Impostor (ad-Dajjāl).
Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ), the Raiser (Ar-Rāfiʿ),
bless with a blessing that brings my wish to me without hardship: for You are the One Who brings,
with a peace that heals the body for me, removing the envious toward a direction other than mine.
O You Who lead to me what has protected from (every) annihilating (woe), and have led to me the good of the second Jumādā.
Bless with a blessing from You, possessed of blessings, by which You turn toward other than my person the ruinous things,
with a peace that makes the homeland good for me, and leads to me what widens the resting-place.
upon him whom I have praised from the head of the sacred (months) (Muḥarram) to the sixth of the months (Jumādā II), and he is the one who was generous.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And give me mastery, and make (my state) clear, well pleased with me, and raise the pilgrimage on my behalf, fulfilling it.
Give the Messenger of Allah — may Allah bless him — dominion over that by which his loftiness grows.
Bless with a blessing and a peace on my behalf upon him, O All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ), and accept from me.
Turn away toward other than the person of the best of humankind what grieves him, and put glad tidings in its place.
Return to him what gladdens him and what almost escaped him of loftiness, where it is about to (escape).
Increase his beauty, O Beautiful, and gather the wishes for him, and his adversary suppress for him.
I have given the best of creation possession of a praise that abides as long as his grace, and he has granted precedence.
I have made my service clear for the most excellent Prophet, and he preserved me and preserved what is in my tent.
I have raised to Allah the Exalted, for a span, my hand, through His outpouring that He extended to me.
Allah has returned to me of good things what almost escaped me; what makes things escape has not made for me.
The Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ) has drawn to me what benefits me, without harm, and raises me with the wishes.
The Beautiful (Al-Jamīl) has beautified me with a beautifying that shows marvels to the one struck dumb, possessed of bewilderment.
To Him be my gratitude forever over the months; and He has bestowed on me manifestation and purity.
Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), the Raiser (Ar-Rāfiʿ),
bless with a blessing that makes glad tidings eternal for me, that delivers to others than me the Nineteen (guardians of Hell),
with a peace that banishes the Accursed toward others than us, so that we may worship the Helper,
upon the Prophet and Messenger Aḥmad, O You Who through him drove grief toward others than me,
upon his Family and his Companions; and take away every boastful rival toward others than me: let him go.
And lead to me forever the mighty, the mightiest, O You Who through him disgraced whoever grew arrogant,
without encounter (with evil) and without turbidity, O Lord of time, of creation and of decree.
O You Who protected me from expulsion, from stratagem and delusion, as from gradual luring (istidrāj).
Bless with a blessing that softens hearts for me, and leads to me curdled milk together with (fresh) milk,
with a peace that drives what has grieved toward a direction other than mine, and whoever did evil,
upon the brave one, possessed of the Companions, the Effacer (al-Māḥī), him whose love made lances needless.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
